title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Assignment and Engagement of Persons with Specialized Knowledge to Participate in Case Handling (Trial)

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Provisions are formulated for the purpose of regulating and promoting the assignment and engagement by the People's Procuratorate of persons with specialized knowledge to participate in case handling, in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other legal provisions, and in light of the actual work of the procuratorate.

Article 2 For the purpose of these Provisions, "persons with specialized knowledge" means persons who use specialized knowledge to participate in the case handling activities of the People's Procuratorate and assist in resolving specialized issues or rendering opinions, but excludes persons who participate in case handling as expert appraisers.
For the purpose of these Provisions, "specialized knowledge" means the understanding and mastery by persons in specific fields of expertise of knowledge and experience of a professional and technical nature.

Article 4 Where the People's Procuratorate engages a person outside the procuratorial organ to participate in case handling as a person with specialized knowledge, it shall verify the person's valid identity documents and the materials that can prove that the person meets the requirements set forth in Paragraph 1 of Article 3 of these Provisions.
Article 5 A People's Procuratorate with the necessary conditions may designate a specialized department responsible for establishing a recommended roster of persons with specialized knowledge.

Article 6 The provisions concerning the disqualification of expert appraisers as provided in the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other legal provisions shall apply to the disqualification of persons with specialized knowledge.

Article 10 During the court hearing of a criminal case, the People's Procuratorate may apply to the People's Court to notify a person with specialized knowledge to appear in court and give opinions on the appraisal opinion made by the expert appraiser.

Article 11 During the court hearing of a criminal case, where the public prosecutor needs assistance in presenting, playing, or demonstrating evidence material involving specialized issues, the People's Procuratorate may assign or engage a person with specialized knowledge to operate.

Article 13 During the court hearing of a public interest litigation case, the People's Procuratorate may apply to the People's Court to notify a person with specialized knowledge to appear in court and give opinions on the appraisal opinion made by the expert appraiser or on professional issues.

Article 16 The People's Procuratorate shall, according to law, ensure the safety of persons with specialized knowledge who are assigned or engaged to participate in case handling and their close relatives.
Where any person threatens, insults, assaults, retaliates against, or commits other acts against a person with specialized knowledge or his or her close relatives, which constitutes an illegal act or a crime, the People's Procuratorate shall transfer the matter to the public security organ for handling; where the circumstances are minor, the person shall be given criticism and education or a reprimand.

Article 17 The expenses for transportation, accommodation, meals, and other costs incurred by a person with specialized knowledge due to participation in case handling shall be borne by the People's Procuratorate. For engaged persons with specialized knowledge, appropriate remuneration shall be given.
The aforesaid expenses shall be disbursed from the case handling operational funds of the People's Procuratorate.

Article 18 A person with specialized knowledge participating in case handling shall abide by legal provisions, follow technical standards and norms, uphold professional ethics, and adhere to the principle of objectivity and fairness.

Article 19 A person with specialized knowledge shall keep confidential the state secrets, trade secrets, personal privacy, and other content not suitable for disclosure that are learned during participation in case handling.
Article 20 A person with specialized knowledge shall properly keep, use, and promptly return the evidence and other case file materials that come into contact during participation in case handling.

Article 21 A person with specialized knowledge shall not, in the same case, simultaneously accept the entrustment of a party, defender, or litigation agent in criminal proceedings, a counterparty or litigation agent in civil or administrative proceedings, or the People's Court.

Article 22 Where a person with specialized knowledge violates the provisions of Articles 18 to 21 of these Provisions, commits a major fault, and affects the normal handling of cases, the People's Procuratorate shall suspend such person from participating in case handling as a person with specialized knowledge and shall remove the person from the recommended roster. When necessary, the People's Procuratorate may recommend that the person's employer or relevant department impose administrative sanctions or other sanctions. If the act constitutes an illegal act or a crime, administrative liability or criminal liability shall be pursued according to law.

Article 23 The People's Procuratorates of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government may, in accordance with these Provisions and in light of local actual conditions, formulate specific implementation measures, and shall report them to the Supreme People's Procuratorate for recordation.
Article 24 The Supreme People's Procuratorate shall be responsible for interpreting these Provisions.
Article 25 These Provisions shall be implemented on a trial basis as of the date of promulgation.
